nonblocking_findings.description: This derived page is the only one of the 32 entries in docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json derivedFrom that retains its repository source's first heading. It carries front matter `title: Directional Security Profiles` (line 2) and then `# Directional security profiles` (line 5), copied from docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:1. docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md:131-132 requires a derived page to "retain the site's front matter, remove the duplicate first heading where applicable", and every other derived page follows that rule: docs-site/docs/airs/management.md, docs-site/docs/developer/security.md, docs-site/docs/developer/stability.md, docs-site/docs/core/models.md and the rest begin with front matter and an H2, with no `^# ` line (only site-authored pages such as docs-site/docs/index.md:6 and docs-site/docs/about/release-notes.md:7 keep an H1). The rendered heading also differs in case from the sidebar/metadata title. The recorded `npm run build` cannot detect this; it is a convention divergence, not a broken page.

The derived page does contain site-only text with no counterpart in the published repository guide: docs-site/docs/airs/directional-profiles.md:140-147 adds the two-package TLS cross-reference to /developer/security#024-tls-dependency-patches, changes "production dependencies remain" (docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:137) to "direct dependency declarations remain", and adds release-notes and live-qualification pointers. nonblocking_findings.description: The `docs/developer/live-qualification.md` entry records only sourcePath/sourceCommit/sourceSha256 (5ae2460c, equal to the docs/LIVE_ACCEPTANCE.md digest in attempt-05.source.json:84), implying the derived page is a pure translation of the published base. nonblocking_findings.description: release_source_files() binds only each entry's top-level `sourcePath`, so the nested provenance sources introduced by the attempt-04 corrections are not generically bound in the attempt manifest: `supplementalSource.sourcePath` at docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json:104 (CHANGELOG.md) and :115 (docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md), and the `forwardReference.sourcePath` values at :126, :138 and :148. Both currently reach attempt-05.source.json only because they happen to be listed in REFERENCES (lines 49), so a future supplemental or forward-reference source outside REFERENCES would carry a recorded sourceSha256 that the snapshot never freezes, and the new regression test at docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py:88-103 asserts only the top-level sourcePath values.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Extend release_source_files() to also collect `supplementalSource.sourcePath` and `forwardReference.sourcePath` (validating each is a string) and assert in test_every_release_derived_source_is_bound_in_snapshot that every nested sourcePath in release024DerivedSources also appears in snapshot()['files'].
